core_principles: Sharp Edges (No rounded corners larger than 2px)
anti_patterns: Large rounded corners (Use rounded-sm or none)
Gradients on backgrounds (Use solid or subtle noise)

typography.rules: Headings in Space Grotesk (Uppercase preferred for H1). All numbers, tables, and data in JetBrains Mono. UI labels in Inter.

layout.sidebar: Collapsible, Icon-only mode support, Fixed Left

components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-sm), uppercase text, 1px border. Hover: invert or glow.
components.cards: Background #0A0A0A, Border 1px solid #27272a. Header separated by border. No shadow.
components.inputs: Background #000, Border 1px #333. Focus: Border #3b82f6 (No ring blur). Font: JetBrains Mono.
components.tables: Dense rows (h-8 or h-10). Header: Uppercase, text-xs, text-muted-foreground. Striped rows optional (opacity 0.02).
components.charts: Recharts. No grid lines (or very subtle #222). Tooltips: Custom dark style. Colors: Green/Red for price action, Blue/Purple for volume/indicators.

dashboard_hub.layout: Grid of shortcut cards + System Health Summary + Top Market Movers

quant_dashboard.layout: 3-column dense layout. Left: Asset List. Center: Main Chart (Large). Right: Order Book & Trades.

macro_regime.layout: Bento grid of heatmaps and gauges.
macro_regime.components: Regime Indicator (Inflation vs Growth), Correlation Matrix.

world_intel_map.background: Dark map image or GeoJSON rendering.
world_intel_map.markers: Pulsing radar dots (CSS animation) for events.

terminal.layout: Console aesthetic. Black background. Green monospace text.
terminal.features: Command history, Autocomplete, JSON output formatting.

hedge_fund_automation_v2.layout: Split pane: Code Editor (Monaco style) | Debug Console.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: IMMEDIATELY update /app/frontend/src/index.css with the provided CSS variables to establish the Dark Theme.
Add the Google Fonts import to /app/frontend/public/index.html head.
Use 'rounded-sm' or 'rounded-none' for ALL shadcn components to enforce the sharp 'Financial Terminal' look.
For charts, use Recharts with 'dark' theme overrides (hide grid lines, use custom tooltips).
Use 'lucide-react' icons with stroke-width={1.5} for a thin, precise look.
Ensure the sidebar is collapsible to maximize screen real estate for data.
Use the provided image_urls for section backgrounds where applicable (e.g., World Map, Login).
For 'Terminal', use a pure black background (#000000) distinct from the main app background (#050505).
